interface.title: Wildlife Monitor (Raspberry Pi camera-trap dashboard)
interface.stage_of_work: Data collection and first-pass review of field recordings
interface.what_it_is_for: Lets a naturalist browse motion-triggered, scheduled and manual camera-trap clips that a model has classified by animal, look over daily and per-species statistics, star notable sightings, re-run classification, and start a test capture.

data.note: There were 8 seeded detections (#1–#8): fox, bird (robin), cat, squirrel, hedgehog, rabbit, dog, and one unclassified. The videos are placeholders in simulation mode, so the video player never plays and no key-frame or bounding-box images appear. The thumbnails are broken images. My testing changed the data: re-classifying #2 turned 'bird (robin) 65%' into 'unknown (robin)'. I un-highlighted #2 and highlighted #1. The two test captures I made (#9 and #10) I deleted again.
